model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the percentage of respondents who consider various measures to be important for combating “the shadow economy” in their country, with the question title translating to “Which measures do you consider most important to be adopted to combat the ‘shadow economy’ in the country?” The vertical axis lists 14 distinct policy measures in Bulgarian, ordered from top to bottom, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents, scaled linearly from 0% to 15% with tick marks at every 5 percentage point interval. Each bar corresponds to a specific measure and its length visually represents the percentage of respondents who selected it; the exact percentage is labeled at the end of each bar. The bars are colored either blue or red, with blue bars representing measures such as “Strengthen border control” (2%), “Restrict credit access conditions” (3%), “Strengthen tax control” (9%), “Adopt stricter laws” (5%), “Reduce VAT” (5%), “Reduce income tax on profits” (3%), and “Reduce personal income tax” (3%). Red bars represent measures such as “Limit mafia activities” (10%), “Reduce corruption” (13%), “Improve administrative quality” (13%), and “Introduce more effective business incentives” (13%). The bars are not sorted by value; instead, they are listed in a fixed vertical order as presented in the question. There are no visual emphasis indicators such as shading, bolding, or outlines applied to any of the bars.
